source.name: Sportcal, 'Emirates extends FA Cup title sponsorship to 2028'
source.quote: The new agreement is reportedly valued at around £10 million ($12.8 million) per season.
source.note: Emirates' own release (emirates.com media centre, 2024-08-01) confirms the extension but states no value.

note: Title sponsor since 2015, renewed 2018 and 2021, extended on 1 Aug 2024 for four years through 2027-28; the value is a press report.
